stories.title: Police: Las Vegas man punched, stomped acquaintance’s head for 15 minutes outside convenience store
stories.summary: Quinton Graham, 31, is charged in the beating death of Michael Bagdan.

stories.title: Jacky Rosen bill would limit ICE enforcement operations at airports
stories.summary: Nevada U.S. Sen. Jacky Rosen is introducing a bill that would restrict federal immigration enforcement at airports without judicial warrants and impose new limits on ICE’s access to passenger data.

stories.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks by targeting a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
stories.summary: After about two months without such attacks, Iran has repeatedly targeted U.S. facilities in Bahrain in recent days.

stories.title: Analysis: Don’t blame Adin Hill for Golden Knights bad loss to Dallas
stories.summary: There was plenty of blame to go around for why the Golden Knights lost Tuesday, but none of that falls on Adin Hill.

stories.title: Nevada ranks 49th in housing supply as homebuilding falls behind population growth
stories.summary: Nevada issued 8,986 housing permits from January through August, a 29 percent per-capita decline from the same period last year, according to a UNLV report.

stories.title: 3rd death tied to roller coaster at California’s Six Flags Magic Mountain
stories.summary: A third person has died after riding X2 at Six Flags Magic Mountain a few weeks before two other people allegedly suffered severe brain injuries on the high speed fourth-dimension roller coaster, according to a new report.

stories.title: Renovated midcentury Pinto Lane estate hits market for $4.46M
stories.summary: The 1959 estate sits on nearly an acre and features a private tennis court, resort-style pool, outdoor kitchen and no homeowners association.

stories.title: Graney: UNLV basketball gets close look at elite in blowout loss
stories.summary: The Runnin’ Rebels fell to No. 11 Kansas 102-77 in a Players Era 8 first-round game.

stories.title: This popular preserve near Las Vegas is getting a major makeover
stories.summary: A $66.5 million project will improve about 42 miles of roads inside the Mojave National Preserve in eastern California.

stories.title: Golden Knights blow late lead, lose to Stars in OT
stories.summary: The Golden Knights gave up a two-goal lead in the final 1:18 of regulation and lost to the Dallas Stars in overtime on Tuesday.

stories.title: No. 11 Kansas ends UNLV’s unbeaten start with win in Players Era 8 opener
stories.summary: Sophomore guard Leroy Blyden Jr. led the No. 11 Kansas Jayhawks with a team-high 23 points in a win over UNLV in the opening round of the Players Era 8 tournament.
